Quick7Zip - Change log

v1.0.0 (2026-08-19)
- First stable release of the adaptive GUI and CLI.
- Completed automatic analysis, hybrid compression, encryption, splitting, progress, ratio, and elapsed-time reporting.

v0.1.0 (2026-08-19)
- Initial adaptive compression analysis and 7-Zip execution.
- Added GUI, CLI, AES-256 encryption, split volumes, progress, and cancellation.
